description: Single storey front extension incorporating porch; Single and two storey side to rear extension; Roof light in rear roof slope, Conversion of dwelling house into three flats (2 x 1 bed, 1 x 2 bed), with associated car parking, landscaping, boundary treatment, private amenity space, refuse and cycle storage (Demolition of detached garage)
decision_conditions: <p>The proposal, by reason of the fragmented and contrived subdivision of the rear garden, would fail to provide a practical, or high-quality arrangement of private amenity space for future occupiers and results in a refuse area which is inconvenient for future occupiers due to its siting and convoluted access.&nbsp; As such, the development is contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies D3(D7), D3(D10) and D6 of the London Plan (2021), Policies DM1, DM26 and DM27 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013), the Residential Design Guide SPD (2010) and the Housing Design Standards LPG (2023).</p>

<p><span style="line-height: 115%;">The proposal,
by reason of failure to demonstrate adequate Gross internal floor area fails to
provide a high standard of residential accommodation for future occupiers and
is therefore contrary to the high-quality design aspirations of the National
Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3(D7) and D6 of The London Plan
(2021) and Policies DM1 and DM26 of the Development Management Policies Local
Plan (2013) and the Residential Design Guide SPD (2010) and the Housing Design
Standards LPG (2023).</span></p>

<p>The proposal fails to provide a sufficient number of car parking spaces within the curtilage of the site. The proposal would fail to provide a sufficient level of parking to meet the needs of future occupiers, resulting in an increase in the demand for on-street parking, to the detriment of highway safety and the free flow of traffic. The proposal is therefore contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy CS1 of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policies DM1, DM26 and DM43 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and Policy T6.1 of the London Plan (2021).</p>
